C1_s3_protocol_problem.problem: fit_probe computes the validation MSE after every epoch and keeps the parameters from the epoch that minimise it; _run_scope passes the official validation split as x_val/y_val, and e2_probes then reports metrics on that very split.  The reported S3/S3.1 E2 numbers are therefore optimistic under model selection.
C1_s3_protocol_problem.corrected_here: selection uses an inner dev set of official-train plots only; the final readout is refit on all official train plots with a fixed epoch rule and evaluated once on official validation.
